name: plain_no_entry_no_wrong_true
spec_quote: A platform WITHOUT an entry keeps the plain rule: any wrong answer fails the bar. An application that was never submitted counts toward nothing.

name: plain_no_entry_any_wrong_false
spec_quote: A platform WITHOUT an entry keeps the plain rule: any wrong answer fails the bar.

name: recert_need_two_exact_since_and_after_true
spec_quote: the wrong-answer bar is passed when BOTH hold: 1. at least `need` applications of that platform were SUBMITTED at or after `since` (the time of the submit), and 2. none of those applications submitted at or after `since` has a wrong answer.

name: recert_prior_wrong_ignored_but_total_counted
